name: Nicodrake
look: a majestic serpentine dragon of swirling iridescent smoke with golden ash scales, golden horns, glowing amber eyes and a tobacco-leaf mane
entry: Ancient murals depict shamans summoning Nicodrake through ceremonial braziers to commune with spirits and sharpen their minds.
how: Wild: ultra-rare in the Ashtray Wastes (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto), level 60-70.
It learns Alkaloid Roar at level 40.
